source_citation: Diggs, Lipscomb & O'Kennon (1999), Shinners & Mahler's Illustrated Flora of North Central Texas

morphology_source_reported.stems: Erect to ascending, 30–60 cm long; bushy-branched

habitat_source_reported: Prairies on limestone or calcareous clay
flowering_source_reported: Mid-Jun–mid-Jul; mowed plants sometimes to Sep
cautions: Does not establish Hays County occurrence or nativity; do not export to identification scoring without taxon review
